method.admission: A call completes only when it returns without error and its output passes mechanical admission after the clock stops: SVG must parse as XML to an SVG namespace root with finite positive size; PNG must contain complete decodable image data with positive dimensions; terminal text must be non-empty after removing control sequences. Error placeholders (aria-roledescription="error"), outputs led by a renderer error phrase absent from the source, and terminal text that only echoes the source are failures. A cheap meaning check then rejects fallback renders: drawn SVG text or terminal text that shows the source header line verbatim, or at least three and at least half of its syntax-bearing statements (arrows, shape brackets, key: value fields), was drawn from the source text rather than from an understood diagram. Native PNG bytes are not read for text, so the check covers PNG only when it is converted from the candidate SVG. Whether the drawing is correct is judged by Drawing Correctness; outputs are not retained.
method.elapsed: Sum of awaited render/export calls, including failures; initialization, warm-up, reporting and cleanup excluded. Native CLI includes process startup.
method.png: Browser SVG + shared Chromium canvas PNG conversion unless a prepared native PNG path is available. No image inspection.

rankingRule.scope: Rank SVG, PNG and terminal text separately through the declared public execution paths. Native CLI time includes per-example process startup.
rankingRule.incomplete: Fewer than three complete runs, or mixed versions/boundaries, remain unranked.
